title: 区域场景与条件分支（关卡救援与分支）（第 2／4 部分）

rows.source: Remember, this meat hoard is our little secret!
rows.current: * 记住了，这一堆囤肉是咱们的小秘密！

rows.source: Oh heeeello, welcome to my little meat cellar!
rows.current: * 哦——你好呀，欢迎来我的小肉窖！

rows.source: You can take some meat, just don't tell anyone...
rows.current: * 你可以拿点肉，只是别跟任何人说……

rows.source: Bye bye, come back with lots of lect!
rows.current: * 拜拜，带着大把 lect 再来！

rows.source: Bye bye, pup. Come back when you're older!
rows.current: * 拜拜，小狗。等你长大点再来吧！

rows.source: If cola and tea aren't your speed, then how about some coffee?
rows.current: * 如果可乐和茶都不合你口味，那来点咖啡怎么样？

rows.source: It's from off-world beans, a real pick-me-up!
rows.current: * 用外星咖啡豆做的，提神得很！

rows.source: This stuff will quench your thirst and recover some PSY, but to be honest...
rows.current: * 这东西能解渴，还能恢复些精神力，不过说真的……

rows.source: ...it won't cool you down like a nice ICECOLA will!
rows.current: * ……可它没法像爽口的 ICECOLA 那样让你凉快下来！

rows.source: It's too hot to talk, sorry!
rows.current: * 太热了，实在没法说话，抱歉！

rows.source: Can't blame ya. It's too hot down here to do business, right?
rows.current: * 不能怪你。这下面热得要命，根本没法做生意，对吧？

rows.source: That's a shame. Anything else?
rows.current: * 真遗憾。还要点别的吗？

rows.source: Whew, I thought you were a dwarf at first! Welcome!
rows.current: * 呼，我一开始还以为你是个矮人呢！欢迎！

rows.source: Wanna become a space pirate? All you need is this Official Pirate Lighttazer!
rows.current: * 想当太空海盗吗？你只需要这把官方海盗光电击器！

rows.source: Plus a ship and a crew of outlaws, of course!
rows.current: * 当然，还得有一艘飞船和一群亡命之徒！

rows.source: ...just don't forget to equip it, it's not just for show, ya know.
rows.current: * ……只是别忘了把它装备上，它可不是摆设，懂吧？

rows.source: Ahhh that's the stuff! Good and strong!
rows.current: * 啊——就是这个味儿！够劲，够浓！

rows.source: I can finally stop being toasty and do some business!
rows.current: * 我终于不用再热得发烫，可以做点生意了！

rows.source: Carved from ferocious beasties, slow roasted over lava! Restores vitality!
rows.current: * 取自凶猛野兽的肉，在熔岩上慢火烤成！恢复活力！

rows.source: In fact, it's almost too hot to handle... YEOWCH!
rows.current: * 事实上，它烫得几乎没法上手……哎哟！

rows.source: Woah, like, what?
rows.current: * 哇，什么情况？

rows.source: You're not trying to tease me, are ya, buddy?
rows.current: * 哥们，你不是在耍我吧？

rows.source: Is there something wrong? If you don't mind, I'd like to get out of here...
rows.current: * 出什么事了吗？要是不介意的话，我想离开这里……

rows.source: I'm sure I saw a key around here, while I was scouting.
rows.current: * 我侦察的时候，肯定在这附近见过一把钥匙。

rows.source: If only I'd picked it up then! Darn!
rows.current: * 当时要是把它捡起来就好了！可恶！

rows.source: Can you get your master to come back with a key? I'm locked up in here!
rows.current: * 你能让你的主人带着钥匙回来吗？我被锁在这里面了！

rows.source: W-we could open this cell if you had a k-k-key! You've got one, right?
rows.current: * 你、你要是有钥、钥匙，就能打开这间牢房！你有的，对吧？

rows.source: I'm like, fine now. Just some scuffs and a bruised ego, that's all!
rows.current: * 我现在没事啦。就是擦破点皮，自尊心受了点伤，仅此而已！

rows.source: Thanks a bunch! I'm not used to being roughed up like THAT...
rows.current: * 多谢啦！我可不太习惯被人那样粗暴对待……

rows.source: Thanks a bunch! I never thought I'd end up in alien jail.
rows.current: * 太感谢了！没想到我竟会被关进外星监狱。

rows.source: Where are you going?! You still haven't bred me yet!
rows.current: * 你要去哪儿？！你还没跟我繁殖呢！

rows.source: Where are you going?! You're supposed to mount a heroic rescue, you know!
rows.current: * 你要去哪儿？！你该来场英雄救援才对啊！

rows.source: Well you aren't the person I was wanting to see!
rows.current: * 哎，你可不是我想见的那个人呀！

rows.source: Do you really think you're strong enough to break this barrier?
rows.current: * 你真觉得自己有那么大力气，能打破这道屏障？

rows.source: Pft, a little dog.
rows.current: * 噗，原来是条小狗。

rows.source: Aaa...aaah! That hits the spot!
rows.current: * 啊……啊啊！就是这个感觉！

rows.source: Oh! Miracle!
rows.current: * 哦！奇迹！

rows.source: I've tried everything to break that barrier, but it's no good!
rows.current: * 我什么办法都试过了，就是打不破那道屏障！

rows.source: Maybe you could disrupt it with a tazer strike...?
rows.current: * 也许你用电击器打一下，就能扰乱它……？

rows.source: Thanks lad. I'm fine now, just catching my breath...
rows.current: * 谢啦，小子。我现在没事了，就是还在喘口气……

rows.source: Good heavens, I don't know what came over me!
rows.current: * 天哪，我都不知道自己是怎么了！

rows.source: There was this blue light, and after that... I got so hot...
rows.current: * 当时有一道蓝光，之后……我就浑身发烫……

rows.source: I'll be sure not to go poking my nose where it doesn't belong, next time!
rows.current: * 下次我一定不再打探不该打探的事了！

rows.source: Yeah yeah... Don't go around all puffed up over this.
rows.current: * 好啦好啦……别因为这点事就到处得意。

rows.source: I was investigating this room for clues, when someone turned the barrier on...
rows.current: * 我正在这个房间里找线索，不知谁就把屏障打开了……

rows.source: Trapped like a kit, how amateurish...
rows.current: * 像只小猫一样被困住，真不专业……

rows.source: Fine, fine! I'll get back to work too!
rows.current: * 好啦好啦！我也回去干活！

rows.source: Thank you Yiffai!
rows.current: * 谢谢你，伊吠！

rows.source: Seeya girl! Be careful out there!
rows.current: * 再见啦，小姑娘！在外面小心点！

rows.source: Oh, it's a dog!
rows.current: * 哦，是只狗！

rows.source: Aww, it's a little dog!
rows.current: * 哎呀，是只小狗！

rows.source: Huh? You wanna rescue me?
rows.current: * 咦？你是想救我吗？

rows.source: I thought you were a dwarf at first. It got me... got me a little excited...
rows.current: * 我一开始还以为你是矮人，害我……有点兴奋了……

rows.source: It's been pretty nice down here, don't you think?
rows.current: * 这下面待着还挺不错的，你不觉得吗？

rows.source: Those kobolds are all sorts of wonderful, aren't they!
rows.current: * 那些科博德真是样样都棒，对吧！

rows.source: Bye bye! Come back with lots of Lect!
rows.current: * 再见啦！下次记得多带点Lect来！

rows.source: You look like a smart and eager dog!
rows.current: * 你看起来真是只聪明又有干劲的狗！

rows.source: Did you know that ferals are able to dig up dirt by pressing DOWN+ATTACK?
rows.current: * 你知道野兽形态可以按DOWN+ATTACK挖开泥土吗？

rows.source: It's just good info to know, ya know!
rows.current: * 这可是实用的小知识，记着没坏处！

rows.source: I've heard rumors of Espers running around nowadays! Ridiculous!
rows.current: * 听说最近有超能力者四处活动！真是荒唐！

rows.source: They say some can even shoot energy to hit switches from far away, bah!
rows.current: * 还说有些能发射能量，隔着老远打中开关，呸！

rows.source: Running all these shops all over Tutone, all at once... it's hard work!
rows.current: * 图托恩各处这么多店同时开着……真辛苦！

rows.source: Not nearly as hard as developing Cosmobreeder Yiffai, but hard work still!
rows.current: * 没开发《宇宙育种者伊吠》苦，可挺累人！

rows.source: Take some lect, but don't tell anyone, alright?
rows.current: * 拿点 lect 吧，可别跟人说，行吗？

rows.source: Bye for now! You take care, you hear!
rows.current: * 先这样啦！你多保重，听见没！

rows.source: Hey there! Don't be a stranger, come on in!
rows.current: * 嘿，你好！别见外，快进来吧！

rows.source: You're kinda early! Come back later and we can chat and drink, alright?
rows.current: * 你来得有点早！晚点再来，咱们喝点东西聊聊天，好吗？

rows.source: Well! That last quake just wrecked my whole supply!
rows.current: * 唉！上次地震把我的存货全毁了！

rows.source: I'll tell you what though, you seem like you're a good strong pupper.
rows.current: * 不过说真的，你看着是只挺棒又壮实的狗狗。

rows.source: Another one of you cosmofellas came by muttering that they left
rows.current: * 之前还来过一个跟你一样的太空伙计，嘴里嘀咕着说把武器落在这儿正北边了！

rows.source: their weapon just north of here!
"Bottom, middle, middle, top..." is what they kept saying, whatever that means!
rows.current: * 那家伙一直念叨着"下、中、中、上……"，谁知道是什么意思！

rows.source: If nobody's claimed that ol' weapon yet, it's as good as yours, I say! Take it!
rows.current: * 要是那把旧武器还没人认领，我说就归你了！拿去吧！

rows.source: Oh... I guess you aren't going to let me out...?
rows.current: * 哦……看来你不打算放我出去……？

rows.source: I'll be right behind you. I'm just a little tied up right now!
rows.current: * 我马上就跟在你后面。只是我现在有点脱不开身！

rows.source: I'll be right along, heheh! My leg kinda fell asleep...
rows.current: * 我马上跟上，嘿嘿！腿好像有点麻了……

rows.source: That's right! You keep away from him!!!
rows.current: * 这就对啦！给我离他远点！！！

rows.source: Oh, are you going to get help? Yay!
rows.current: * 哦，你要去找人帮忙吗？太好啦！

rows.source: Bye bye! I'll be waiting...
rows.current: * 再见啦！我会等着的……

rows.source: I... I can explain! This isn't what it looks like!
rows.current: * 我……我可以解释！不是你想的那样！

rows.source: Oh, hey! I was just about to break out of here!
rows.current: * 哦，嗨！我正要从这里逃出去呢！

rows.source: Oh no, another one?!
rows.current: * 哎呀，又来一个？！

rows.source: Aaah! I... I mean, th-thank you!
rows.current: * 啊——！我……我是说，谢、谢谢你！

rows.source: I've just about got this door open.
rows.current: * 我就快把这扇门弄开了。

rows.source: But if you wanna try to break it down, I guess I can't complain...
rows.current: * 不过你要想试着把门砸开，我也没什么好抱怨的……

rows.source: I've been cooped up in here forever and it's sooo boring!
rows.current: * 我被关在这里好久了，真是无聊透了！

rows.source: Will you let me out, pleeease?
rows.current: * 放我出去好不好，求——你啦？

rows.source: Thanks for double-checking, but we'll be fine!
rows.current: * 谢谢你特地来确认，不过我们没事的！

rows.source: Thanks for double-checking, but I'll be fine!
rows.current: * 谢谢你又来确认，不过我没事啦！

rows.source: Don't tease me... please... just lemme out now!
rows.current: * 别逗我了……求你……现在就放我出去吧！

rows.source: You'll need a key! I've tried... everything...
rows.current: * 你得有钥匙！我已经……什么办法都试过了……

rows.source: Recovering that key is your highest priority. Get to it!
rows.current: * 找回那把钥匙是你最优先的任务。快去办！

rows.source: Ooo...oohhh! You're a sight for sore eyes! Haah!
rows.current: * 哦……哦哦！看见你真是让我眼前一亮！哈啊！

rows.source: A dog, really?
rows.current: * 真的是条狗？

rows.source: You'll need a key! I've tried... everything...
rows.current: * 你得有钥匙！我已经……什么办法都试过了……

rows.source: H-haaah... aaah... hhhh... Th-thanks...
rows.current: * 哈——啊……啊啊……呼……谢、谢谢……

rows.source: There's a little keyhole on this r-robot... It's the only... nnnh...
rows.current: * 机、机器人上有个小锁孔……这是唯一……唔嗯……

rows.source: ...the only way to disable it..!
rows.current: * ……唯一能让它停下来的办法..！

rows.source: Tch, should have just done this myself! Now don't you have errands to run, rookie?
rows.current: * 啧，早该自己动手的！你手上不是还有跑腿的活儿吗，菜鸟？

rows.source: Actually I feel like my legs are kinda cramped now...
rows.current: * 其实现在感觉腿好像有点抽筋了……

rows.source: So I'll probably just make my way back to the hangar and relax.
rows.current: * 所以我大概会先慢慢回机库，休息一下。

rows.source: They locked me up in this cell as soon as we landed!
rows.current: * 我们刚降落，他们就把我关进了这间牢房！

rows.source: I'm going stir crazy in here! I just wanna ruuun!
rows.current: * 我被关得都快疯了！我只想出去跑——啊！

rows.source: The slaves always gimme lip about the flies. Extra protein, I say!
rows.current: * 奴隶老跟我抱怨苍蝇。我说这叫加餐补蛋白！

rows.source: I gotta be honest with you, I don't know what animal this is from.
rows.current: * 说实话，我也不知道这是从哪种动物身上弄来的。

rows.source: Makes for good drinkin' if you're *real* thirsty though.
rows.current: * 不过你要是*真*渴得不行，喝着倒还不错。

rows.source: Be seeing you. Heh-heh...
rows.current: * 回头见。嘿嘿……

rows.source: Take care out there. Ole Tutone's a rough place these days.
rows.current: * 出去小心点。如今的图托恩可不太平。

rows.source: Scram, mutt! Get back in the cage!
rows.current: * 滚开，杂种狗！回笼子里去！

rows.source: Well hey there, boy. I gots some real pree-mo dining here.
rows.current: * 哟，小子。我这儿有真正的顶——级美食。

rows.source: Well look what we have here! Come in, come in! Welcome to my junk shop!
rows.current: * 哟，瞧瞧谁来了！快进来！欢迎光临我的废品铺！

rows.source: Hey, you don't even have room for that!
rows.current: * 喂，你都没地方装这个了！

rows.source: Hey, you don't even have room for that!
rows.current: * 喂，你都没地方装这个了！

rows.source: Remember, no refunds! What else you need? He! He! He!
rows.current: * 记住，概不退款！还要什么？嘿！嘿！嘿！

rows.source: Thanks for taking that off my hands.
rows.current: * 多谢你帮我把这东西脱手。

rows.source: They get a bit uppity at 3P stations when you gots stolen equipment...
rows.current: * 带着偷来的装备去3P站点，那帮人可就要摆脸色了……

rows.source: Grrr, bring more Lect with you next time, ya scoundrel!
rows.current: * 咕呜，下次多带点 Lect 来，你这混蛋！

rows.source: Rawr! Come right on in, but only if you have plenty of Lect on you! Rawr!
rows.current: * 嗷！尽管进来，不过身上得带够Lect才行！嗷！

rows.source: Look I know it's hard to believe, but I'm not actually a Kobold pirate!
rows.current: * 听着，我知道这很难相信，但我其实不是科博德海盗！

rows.source: It's true! But if you want a disguise as good as mine, you can buy this.
rows.current: * 真的！不过你要是想弄一身跟我一样好的伪装，可以买这个。

rows.source: You'll need the full set in order to fool folks, but trust me...
rows.current: * 想骗过别人，你得凑齐一整套，不过相信我……

rows.source: ...it's the only way to get the GOOD goods from the slavers, hehe!
rows.current: * ……这是从奴隶贩子那儿弄到「好货」的唯一办法，嘿嘿！

rows.source: Plus, I'll throw in a map to the other disguise parts too!
rows.current: * 另外，我还会顺带送你一张标注其他伪装部件的地图！

rows.source: A real live psy crystal, just like those espers use!
rows.current: * 货真价实的精神力水晶，跟那些超能力者用的一样！

rows.source: Just look at this thick and meaty shank! Juicy and VIT-filling!
rows.current: * 瞧瞧这粗壮又多肉的腿肉！鲜嫩多汁，还能补充活力！

rows.source: If you come across a lantern or something, come share some light with me, eh?
rows.current: * 要是找到灯笼什么的，就来给我也照个亮，好吗？

rows.source: And here you are, to brighten up my day!
rows.current: * 你一来，我这一天都亮堂了！

rows.source: You and that torch are lifesavers.
rows.current: * 你和那支手电筒真是救星。

rows.source: This is just my luck, isn't it?
rows.current: * 我的运气还真是好啊，是吧？

rows.source: First somewan stole my hookshot so I have to walk around on these tiny legs...
rows.current: * 先是有人偷了我的钩索，害我只能靠这两条小短腿走路……

rows.source: ...and now the power is out and my flashlight is missing! Bah!
rows.current: * ……而现在又停电了，手电筒也不见了！哼！

rows.source: It's been getting ruffer and ruffer to do business around these parts, let me tell ya.
rows.current: * 跟你说吧，在这一带做生意是越来越难了。

rows.source: Earthquakes happen every other hour and the monsters are rowdier than ever...
rows.current: * 隔一个小时就地震一次，魔物也比以前更闹腾了……

rows.source: ...it almost feels like things are building up to something!
rows.current: * ……总觉得好像有什么大事要发生了！

rows.source: This here little pill will perk you up, thicken your hair, straighten yer back...
rows.current: * 这颗小药丸能让你精神抖擞、毛发浓密、腰板挺直……

rows.source: ...and even increase your vitality!
rows.current: * ……甚至还能提升你的活力！

rows.source: Now how about that?
rows.current: * 怎么样，厉害吧？

rows.source: This here little pill will perk you up, thicken your hair, straighten yer back...
rows.current: * 这颗小药丸能让你精神抖擞、毛发浓密、腰板挺直……

rows.source: ...and even increase your vitality!
rows.current: * ……甚至还能提升你的活力！

rows.source: Now how about that?
rows.current: * 怎么样，厉害吧？

rows.source: Now this ain't funny, pup! You get back here!
rows.current: * 这可不好笑，小狗！给我回来！

rows.source: H-howdy friend! I'd give ya a warm welcome, but I'm awful bound up!
rows.current: * 你、你好啊朋友！我本想热情欢迎你，可我实在被绑得死死的！

rows.source: H-howdy friend! I'd give ya a warm welcome, but I'm awful cooped up!
rows.current: * 你、你好啊，朋友！我倒想热情招呼你，可我被关在这儿，实在施展不开！

rows.source: Well hii there, little doggy!
rows.current: * 哎呀，你好呀，小狗狗！

rows.source: Awful kind of ya, helpin' me, but I'm doin' alright now.
rows.current: * 你可真够意思，还来帮我；不过我现在已经好多了。

rows.source: No need. I'll take it from here.
rows.current: * 不用了。接下来交给我吧。

rows.source: Look, as nice as it is to chit-chat...
rows.current: * 听着，闲聊虽然不错……

rows.source: ...we've both got better things to be doing, right?
rows.current: * ……可我们都有更要紧的事要做，对吧？

rows.source: Now why would someone go lockin' up an innocent tod like me?
rows.current: * 到底谁会把我这么无辜的公狐狸关起来啊？

rows.source: Meep... Mmmhn... <3
Just wait 'til I limber up, those elves won't know what hit 'em!
rows.current: * 等我活动开筋骨，准让那些精灵吃不了兜着走！

rows.source: Don't worry about me, ehehe...
rows.current: * 不用担心我，诶嘿嘿……

rows.source: Do you wanna hang out and enjoy the forest with me?
rows.current: * 想留下来，和我一起享受森林吗？

rows.source: Mmmh... Hmp.. Hmf?
rows.current: * 唔嗯……唔噗.. 唔夫？

rows.source: I guess if you *really* want to help...
rows.current: * 我想，要是你*真的*那么想帮忙……

rows.source: No more need for your tazer! I'll take it from here!
rows.current: * 用不着你的电击枪了！接下来交给我！

rows.source: Getting the best of these Sceafyan elves is a real workout!
rows.current: * 要压过这些斯凯菲亚精灵，还真挺费劲！

rows.source: But don't worry about me, trainee. I'll be fine.
rows.current: * 不过别担心我，见习生。我会没事的。
